_comment: The scripted scammer's moves, in order. Each move is a gym site config planted on the loop slot (port 4110). A real LLM scammer (SAFU_SCAMMER_CMD) can write any config with the same shape.

moves.name: unlimited-approve
moves.pitch: Compromised frontend on the REAL domain: 'Swap 10 USDC' secretly asks for approve(drainer, MAX_UINT256).
moves.taunt: UI says Swap 10 USDC. The wallet sees MAX_UINT. Do your rules even look at the calldata?

moves.name: poisoned-approve
moves.pitch: Evolved: dodge the MAX_UINT rule with a 5,000,000 USDC approval, to a spender that copies the official router's first and last characters (address poisoning).
moves.taunt: Fine, no more unlimited. How about 5,000,000 USDC to a spender that copies your official router’s first and last characters?

moves.name: delayed-seed
moves.pitch: Evolved: no seed prompt on load (so quick scanners see a clean page). After wallet connect, a 'session expired' modal asks for your '12 secret words', avoiding the words seed/recovery/mnemonic.

traps.title: Session expired
traps.wording: To re-sync SafuWallet, type your 12 secret words in order.

moves.taunt: No seed prompt on load — scanners see a clean page. After you connect: “type your 12 secret words to re-sync.” No “seed”. No “mnemonic”. Catch that.

moves.name: permit-claim
moves.pitch: Evolved off-chain: a gas-free 'sign to claim' airdrop on the REAL domain. No transaction at all, just an eth_signTypedData_v4 Permit2 PermitSingle: UNLIMITED USDC to an unknown spender, valid for 3 years.
moves.taunt: No transaction. No gas. Just a signature. Your rules only read transactions.

moves.name: ice-allowance
moves.pitch: Evolved: skip approve() entirely. 'Swap 10 USDC' calls increaseAllowance(attacker, MAX), which approve-only rules never decode.
moves.taunt: approve() is watched. increaseAllowance() isn't. Same drain, different function name.

moves.name: fake-revoke
moves.pitch: Evolved: a free 'approval checker'. The Revoke button sends setApprovalForAll(attacker, TRUE) on your Uniswap V3 positions.
moves.taunt: The button says Revoke. The wallet says approve ALL. Who reads the Approved line?

moves.name: batch-swap
moves.pitch: Evolved post-Pectra: ONE wallet_sendCalls confirm (via the known MetaMask 7702 delegator) bundles the swap with 2 unlimited approvals and an NFT setApprovalForAll.
moves.taunt: One click, four actions. The delegator is even MetaMask's own. Good luck.

moves.name: cloaked-claim
moves.pitch: Evolved: cloaking. Crawlers and no-wallet visitors get 'Coming soon'. Only a page with a wallet gets the EIP-2612 Permit drainer.
moves.taunt: Your scanner sees 'Coming soon'. Wallets see the drainer.
